description: This file defines a React component `MindmapCanvas` that renders an interactive mind map using SVG. It handles layout computation, zooming, panning, node interaction, and rendering edges and nodes with labels. The layout employs a BFS-based level positioning for clarity, and node labels are wrapped/truncated for readability. The component manages viewport interactions including zoom and drag, and supports features like node selection and dimming.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates positions for nodes in a graph layout based on BFS levels from the center node, placing nodes in vertical columns per level with vertical stacking, ensuring readable mind map visualization.

methods.name: getNodeColor
methods.description: Determines node fill color based on whether it is center, selected, or dimmed.

methods.name: getNodeStroke
methods.description: Determines node stroke color based on node state (center, selected, dimmed).

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps and truncates node labels into multiple lines, appending ellipsis if needed for readability within label constraints.
